# MOG-20261109-049 原片3 帧时钟与装饰标题

同源历史版本遇到源毫秒时间戳与编码帧时钟的核验失败。复做时保留两种实际时间基准，按现行取证合同核对映射和硬性校验。

原片红色点状标题包含白、蓝、黄轮廓和快速缩放、径向切换，历史实际字体及图层仅近似这些表现。约3.6秒切换应核对相邻实际帧。小字修复也曾柔化地板和脚边纹理。

西语、日语、巴西葡语历史成片为完整六句配音的 best-available 结果。各语种具体字形差异、ASR分歧及质量限制见 evidence:observations。原取证门禁结果及正常速度视听缺口保留。

No direct listening or continuous normal-speed playback performed; encoded full/head/tail ASR and complete decode do not prove naturalness or absence of faint source vocals.
Complete six-turn real dubbed best-available output; quality remains unapproved, with no independent or company/user acceptance.
Portuguese challenge is wider than source and PRONTO key is small; actual glyphs readable in sampled frames. Independent encoded tail recognizes Oh! Peraí!; colloquial tava/Peraí retained.
